meta_title: FFW8 — Far Far West 8-player install guide
meta_description: A beginner-friendly guide to installing FFWFrostburn8 safely on the host PC.
hero_kicker: A field guide for new hosts
hero_description: Set up the Far Far West Frostburn 8-player mod with the included one-click installer. No PowerShell, manual mod folders, or separate UE4SS download required.
hero_note: Recommended: use the Windows ZIP. It contains Setup.exe, a VI/EN quick guide, and SHA-256 checksums.
quick_step_4: Create a room with Allow mods on
critical_title: Only the host installs this build
critical_body: Guests should stay completely vanilla and use the same game version. Five-to-eight-player vanilla-client compatibility is still being tested, so an 8-slot screen is not proof that every network session will stay synchronized.
scope_description: The safest test setup is deliberately simple. Do not install extra tools on every PC.
host_description: The host receives the mod, UE4SS runtime, compatibility settings, and automatic backup in one pass.
host_point_1: Close Far Far West before installing
host_point_2: Use the exact supported game build
host_point_3: Turn on Allow mods when creating the room
guest_description: Guests install nothing for this host-only experiment. This is necessary to test vanilla-client compatibility honestly.
guest_point_1: Use the same Far Far West version as the host
guest_point_2: Do not install UE4SS or FFWFrostburn8
guest_point_3: Join by room code or Steam Invite
preflight_item_2: Far Far West is fully closed
preflight_item_4: Download came from this project's GitHub Release
install_description: Follow these steps in order. The installer detects Steam libraries automatically and refuses to change files while the game is running.
install_step_1_body: Choose FFWFrostburn8-Windows-x64.zip from the newest release. Do not use GitHub's green Code button or either Source code archive.
install_step_2_body: Right-click the ZIP, choose Extract All, then open the extracted folder. Running Setup from inside the ZIP can prevent its embedded files from loading correctly.
install_step_2_tip: Setup.exe should sit beside the guide and checksum files
install_step_3_body: Open FFWFrostburn8-Setup.exe, confirm the detected Far Far West folder, then choose Install / Cài. Wait for the success message before closing it.
install_step_3_tip: No PowerShell or separate UE4SS install is needed
install_step_4_body: Start the game normally. When creating a network room, enable Allow mods before choosing the room type, then invite your vanilla guests.
install_step_4_tip: Without Allow mods, the normal four-row interface is expected
verify_description: With the host alone in an Allow mods room, Current Session should show eight live rows: your host row and seven Invite buttons.
verify_success_title: The local install is working when…
verify_success_1: The game reaches the title screen without a new crash
verify_success_2: An Allow mods room shows all eight session rows
verify_success_3: A normal room still shows the original four rows
verify_limit_title: What this check does not prove
verify_limit_body: Seven Invite buttons prove the local interface expanded; they do not prove that five, six, seven, or eight real clients can join and remain synchronized. Treat the mod as experimental until that matrix is tested.
releases_description: GitHub Releases are shown newest first. Prefer the top card unless you intentionally need an older game build.
release_fallback: Showing the last verified release list
help_description: Start here before changing files manually or disabling Windows security.
faq_smartscreen_q: Windows says the publisher is unknown. Is that the mod failing?
faq_smartscreen_a: No. The current community build is not code-signed, so SmartScreen may show an unknown-publisher warning. Confirm that you downloaded it from the GitHub Release and compare the published SHA-256 checksum. Do not disable Microsoft Defender.
faq_game_path_q: The installer cannot find Far Far West. What should I select?
faq_game_path_a: Select the game's root folder—the folder that contains FarFarWest.exe—not the inner Binaries or Content folder. Steam: Library → Far Far West → Properties → Installed Files → Browse is the quickest way to find it.
faq_access_q: Installation says access denied or files are in use.
faq_access_a: Close Far Far West completely and wait a few seconds. Also close tools that are scanning or locking the game folder, then run Setup again. The installer intentionally refuses to write while the game executable is running.
faq_four_slots_q: I still see only four rows. What did I miss?
faq_four_slots_a: First confirm that you enabled Allow mods while creating the room. Then restart the game after a new installation. A room without Allow mods should remain at four rows by design.
faq_guests_q: Do my friends need the mod too?
faq_guests_a: Not for the current host-only experiment. Keep guests vanilla and on the same game version. Be direct with them that compatibility beyond four players remains unverified.
faq_remove_q: How do I remove it or recover an earlier setup?
faq_remove_a: Close the game and run FFWFrostburn8-Uninstall.exe from the extracted release. It verifies and restores the newest clean pre-install backup, creating a separate safety backup first. If the original backup is missing or damaged, it stops without changing game files.
